overloads.semanticRole: Marks the start of an inline block of SQL statements (closed by End SQL) to be interpreted by the process's current SQL data source.

constraints: Is a keyword, not a callable command with parameters; a block opened with Begin SQL must be closed with a matching End SQL keyword.
Multiple SQL statements on one line must be separated with a semicolon; the 4D Debugger evaluates SQL code line by line.
